title: Glossary — finance & HR terms

prov.label: SIMULATED · would derive from: finance close runbook + Workiva definitions + controllership wiki

rows: Smallest legal entity with a full balance sheet — 23 in SAP, mapped 1:1 to EBS ledgers for the acquired banner
Invoice released for payment only when invoice, PO, and goods receipt agree within tolerance (2% / $200)
Supplier-funded allowances (volume rebates, ad co-op) collected via AR — ≈$2.8B/yr, audited heavily
Per-company-code GL balances extracted on close day 3 — the unit of hand-off from both ERPs to BPC
Removal of intercompany profit and balances at consolidation — manual for EBS entities
Adjustment posted in BPC, not in either ledger — tracked for SOX, target is < 60 per quarter
Lease accounting standard putting ≈2,300 store leases (≈$8.4B ROU assets) on balance sheet
Payroll calculation from gross wages through tax and deductions to net pay — the COBOL engine's core job
Bank-side check fraud control: bank pays only checks matching the issued-file — on all 900 accounts
Oracle tier for EBS 12.1: no new patches, no certifications — compensated by network isolation
